mapper.update: UPDATE duty_info SET appointments_num_made = appointments_num_made + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND del_flag = '0' AND appointments_num_made < appointments_num
UPDATE duty_info SET appointments_num_made = appointments_num_made - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND del_flag = '0' AND appointments_num_made > 0
mapper.sql:
select duty.schedule_id as scheduleId, duty.doctor_id as doctorId, user.nick_name as doctorName, h.hospital_name as hospitalName, dept.dept_name as deptName, duty.duty_date as dutyDate, duty.duty_period as dutyPeriod, duty.appointments_num as appointmentsNum, duty.appointments_num_made as appointmentsNumMade, duty.registration_fee as registrationFee,
duty.del_flag as delFlag, duty.create_by, duty.create_time, duty.update_by, duty.update_time, duty.remark, user.remark as doctorIntroduction from duty_info duty left join sys_user user on duty.doctor_id = user.user_id and user.del_flag = 0 left join sys_dept dept on user.dept_id = dept.dept_id and dept.del_flag = 0 left join sys_user_hospital uh on uh.user_id = user.user_id left join hospital_info h on h.id = uh.hospital_id and h.del_flag = 0

mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN (sum(di.appointments_num) - SUM(di.appointments_num_made)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_available FROM duty_info di left join sys_user user on user.user_id = di.doctor_id and user.del_flag = 0 left join sys_user_hospital suh on user.user_id = suh.user_id left join hospital_info hi on hi.id = suh.hospital_id and hi.del_flag = 0 WHERE di.duty_date = #{date} AND di.del_flag = 0 and hi.hospital_code = #{hospitalCode} and dept_id = #{deptId}
